title: Ready, episode 2: screens before everything
needs: NEW: the girl, about seven, ticking a job on a tablet then running outside
A screen recording of the child app: ticking a job, the stars landing, the five a day (Justin's phone or a demo child, never the real account)
Clip check: s04 and s10 offsets

beats.quote: 9 in 10 parents argue with their kids over screen time.

beats.me: She wants a screen before anything else. How do I change that?

digi: Today: flag one job before screens. Her app says it, not you.
This week: her five a day puts outside and jobs before the timer.
Every job: she ticks it, you tap once, her stars buy minutes.

beats.line: Screen time waits until the jobs are done.
Her five a day. Offline comes first.
All five done. The stars are hers.
Jobs first is just how her day goes.
